acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition
The data was acquired through a Top Speed Data-Dependent acquisition mode using three seconds cycle time.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Alkylation was then performed on top of the filters with 100 µL of 40mM chloroacetamide in 8 M urea, 100mM Tris-HCL pH 8.0 at 37°C for 45 minutes light protected with gentle shaking.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Alkylation was then performed on top of the filters with 100 µL of 40mM chloroacetamide in 8 M urea, 100mM Tris-HCL pH 8.0 at 37°C for 45 minutes light protected with gentle shaking.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Samples were then digested overnight on top of filters at 37°C with 100 µL of proteolytic solution at 1/50 w/w enzyme-to-protein ratio using a combination of mass spectrometry grade trypsin and LysC supplemented with 10mM CaCl2.

collision_energy.evidence: The data was acquired through a Top Speed Data-Dependent acquisition mode using three seconds cycle time. First MS scans were acquired at a resolution of 120,000 (at 200 m/z), with the most intense parent ions selected and fragmented by High Energy collision Dissociation (HCD) with a Normalized Collision Energy (NCE) of 35% using an isolation window of 0.7 m/z.

instrument.value: Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid Mass Spectrometer
instrument.evidence: Each fraction was resuspended in 2% acetonitrile, 0.1% Formic acid and nano-flow separations were performed on an Ultimate 3000 RSLC UHPLC system online connected with an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid Mass Spectrometer (ThermoFisher Scientific).

labeling.evidence: Labeling was achieved with the TMTproTM 18plex isobaric Mass Tagging Kit for 90 minutes at room temperature and reactions were then quenched with hydroxylamine to a final concentration of 0.4% (v/v) for 15 min..

reduction_concentration.evidence: Reduction was performed on top of the filters with 100 µL of 10mM TCEP in 8 M urea, 100mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 at 37°C for 60 minutes with gentle shaking.

reduction_reagent.evidence: Reduction was performed on top of the filters with 100 µL of 10mM TCEP in 8 M urea, 100mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 at 37°C for 60 minutes with gentle shaking.
